title: DecisionProfile
description: FEATURE-0013 DecisionProfile VersionedDefinition (F13-OBJ-003, F13-PROF-001; design §6.1/§7.3; AD-029). Definition content lives in spec. SecurityExceptionRef is structural approval-evidence only. No new resource profile is introduced.

metadata.description: Profile object metadata. metadata.scopeRef is the sole scope authority for the profile object; ExceptionScopeRef inside SecurityExceptionRef is exception-evidence only.

spec.description: DecisionProfile definition content (VersionedDefinition; F13-OBJ-003, F13-PROF-001). Definition content lives in spec.

name.description: Stable profile id; required non-empty. Composite (name, version) registry key.

version.description: Profile semver; required. Composite (name, version) registry key.

lifecycleStatus.description: Profile lifecycle status; inactive rejected by validators.

limits.description: Optional evaluator-specific ceilings that may only narrow ProfileLimits.

scopeSemantics.description: Allowed governance scopes for decisions governed by this profile. Does not create a second scope authority on DecisionRecord/AuditEvent.

allowedScopes.description: Allowed ScopeKind values for governed decisions.

platformAllowed.description: Whether canonical Platform (absent scopeRef) is permitted.

requireEffectivePolicyContext.description: Whether effective policy context is required.

requireDurableRecord.description: Whether a durable DecisionRecord is required.

allowNondeterministicAI.description: Whether nondeterministic AI evaluators are allowed.

failureBehavior.description: Failure, timeout, and insufficient-evidence posture (design §7.3/§7.7). Fail-open requires a valid SecurityExceptionRef.

declaredFailureModes.description: Optional profile-declared failure modes for exception coverage.

securityExceptionRef.description: Optional bounded structural SecurityExceptionRef approval-evidence reference (AD-043). Evidence only; no approval workflow.

validityRules.description: Correction/supersession/revocation and validity carriers (append-only; no in-place rewrite).

defaultValidityMs.description: Optional default validity window in milliseconds.

sensitivityCeiling.description: Closed Sensitivity ceiling PUBLIC < INTERNAL < CONFIDENTIAL < RESTRICTED (F13-SEC-001). Inlined enum (not $ref) because TypeBinding treats $ref as opaque structs.

residencyProfile.description: Optional structural residency declaration (jurisdiction tags only).

items.description: Structural audience projection declaration (F13-SEC-007). Conformance is structural only; no redaction execution.

includes.description: RFC 6901 pointers into the canonical view.

excludes.description: RFC 6901 pointers; overlap with includes is invalid.

idempotencyIdentity.description: Idempotency identity basis for the profile.

limits.description: Profile-owned ceilings within FEATURE-0012 outer bounds (F13-PROF-005). Evaluator ceilings may only narrow.

backwardCompatible.description: Whether the profile declares backward compatibility.
